'''Adapted Devourers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with a spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Devourers are Aquatic Melee Combatants. 

*Their Melee attack is performed through contact damage.

*The Devourers are able to terraform their enviroment by digging an area and filling it with water.

=== Weaknesses ===

* Adapted Devourers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled. But since it is in water...
